'''Polis Massan voiceboxes''' were artificial voiceboxes used by most members of the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] [[Species/Legends|species]], since most members of the species were unable to speak. The voiceboxes, which cost 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] apiece, used [[Electrode/Legends|electrodes]] to turn thoughts into speech.<ref name="Strongholds" />
